fields.name: Appam with Vegetable Stew
fields.description: Soft, bowl-shaped fermented rice hoppers with fluffy spongy centers and lacy crisp edges, served with mildly spiced coconut milk vegetable stew.

fields.name: Vegetable Millet and Lentil Bowl
fields.description: Modern healthy fusion bowl of foxtail millet, simmered lentils, steamed greens, and roasted cumin dressing.

fields.name: Idli with Sambar
fields.description: Soft, steamed fermented rice and black lentil cakes served with a rich, hearty lentil-vegetable stew infused with drumstick and tamarind.

fields.name: Matta Rice with Sardine Curry
fields.description: Fresh coastal sardines (mathi) cooked in a tangy red chili, shallot, and Malabar tamarind (kudampuli) curry, served with matta rice.
fields.malayalam_description: കുത്തരി ചോറും കുടംപുളിയിട്ട് വറ്റിച്ച മത്തിക്കറിയും.

fields.name: Plain Dosa with Sambar
fields.description: Crispy, golden fermented rice and urad dal crepe cooked on a flat griddle, served with aromatic lentil and vegetable sambar.
fields.malayalam_description: സ്വർണ്ണവർണ്ണത്തിൽ ചുട്ടെടുത്ത മൊരിഞ്ഞ ദോശയും കൊതിയൂറും സാമ്പാറും.

fields.name: Idiyappam with Green Gram Curry
fields.description: Delicate steamed rice string hoppers served with protein-packed whole green gram (cherupayar) curry cooked with shallots, coconut, and spices.
fields.malayalam_description: നൂൽപ്പുട്ടും ചെറുപയർ നാടൻ തേങ്ങ ചേർത്തുണ്ടാക്കിയ കറിയും.

fields.name: Wheat Puttu with Green Gram Curry
fields.description: Nutritious roasted whole-wheat flour steamed with fresh coconut layers, accompanied by mildly spiced steamed green gram curry.

fields.name: Ragi Dosa with Sambar
fields.description: Healthy, fiber-rich finger millet (ragi) savory crepes packed with calcium, served with hot Kerala vegetable sambar.
fields.malayalam_description: കാൽസ്യവും നാരുകളും സമൃദ്ധമായ റാഗി ദോശയും സാമ്പാറും.

fields.name: Green Gram Dosa
fields.description: Wholesome, protein-rich batter made of whole soaked green gram and ginger, griddled into crisp savory crepes (Pesarattu style).
fields.malayalam_description: മുഴുവൻ ചെറുപയറും ഇഞ്ചിയും അരച്ചുണ്ടാക്കിയ സ്വാദിഷ്ടമായ പെസരട്ട് ദോശ.

fields.name: Matta Rice with Grilled Fish
fields.description: Steamed unpolished red rice paired with shallow pan-grilled fresh fish marinated in turmeric, crushed chili, and lemon juice.
fields.malayalam_description: കുത്തരി ചോറും കുരുമുളകും മഞ്ഞളും പുരട്ടി പൊള്ളിച്ച മീനും.

fields.name: Vegetable Oats Upma
fields.description: Whole rolled oats roasted and gently simmered with finely chopped carrots, green beans, ginger, mustard seeds, and fresh curry leaves.

fields.name: Vegetable Aval Upma
fields.description: Traditional Kerala flattened rice (poha/aval) tempered with mustard, green chilies, grated ginger, and mixed garden vegetables.
fields.malayalam_description: പച്ചക്കറികളും കടുക് വറവുമിട്ട നാടൻ തവിടുള്ള അവൽ ഉപ്പുമാവ്.

fields.name: Kerala Fish Curry Meal
fields.description: Traditional Kerala lunch thali featuring matta rice, spicy nadan fish curry, vegetable thoran, moru, and crispy poppadom.
fields.malayalam_description: കുത്തരി ചോറും നാടൻ മീൻകറിയും തോരനും മോരും കൂട്ടിയുള്ള ഉച്ചയൂണ്.

fields.name: Broken Wheat Upma
fields.description: Fiber-rich cracked wheat (nurukku gothambu) simmered with vegetables, shallots, and curry leaves for a slow-digesting, healthy breakfast.
fields.malayalam_description: നുറുക്ക് ഗോതമ്പും പച്ചക്കറികളും ചേർത്ത പോഷകസമൃദ്ധമായ ഉപ്പുമാവ്.

fields.name: Matta Rice with Light Chicken Curry
fields.description: Tender chicken pieces simmered in a mildly spiced coriander and shallot sauce, served over wholesome red matta rice.
fields.malayalam_description: കുത്തരി ചോറും മല്ലിയും ചെറിയുള്ളിയും ചേർത്ത നാടൻ ചിക്കൻ കറിയും.

fields.name: Matta Rice with Chicken Pepper Roast
fields.description: Spicy and aromatic chicken pieces dry-roasted with freshly crushed Malabar black pepper, garlic, and curry leaves, served with matta rice.
fields.malayalam_description: കുത്തരി ചോറും കുരുമുളകിട്ട് വരട്ടിയ ചിക്കൻ റോസ്റ്റും.

fields.name: Matta Rice with Egg Curry
fields.description: Hard-boiled eggs cooked in a flavorful Kerala coconut and roasted onion gravy, served over steaming hot red rice.

fields.name: Green Gram Rice Porridge

fields.name: Egg Roast with Whole-Wheat Chapati
fields.description: Soft whole-wheat flatbreads served with hard-boiled eggs sautéed in a thick, spiced onion, tomato, and crushed black pepper gravy.

fields.name: Vegetable Omelette with Whole-Wheat Toast
fields.description: Fluffy country-egg omelette folded with chopped onions, tomatoes, and green herbs, served with toasted whole-wheat bread slices.

fields.name: Idiyappam with Light Chicken Stew
fields.description: Soft steamed string hoppers served with a gentle, fragrant chicken and potato stew simmered in light coconut milk, cinnamon, and cloves.
fields.malayalam_description: നൂൽപ്പുട്ടും നേർത്ത തേങ്ങാപ്പാലിൽ തയ്യാറാക്കിയ ചിക്കൻ സ്റ്റൂവും.

fields.name: Matta Rice with Avial and Thoran
fields.description: Authentic Kerala red matta rice served with traditional avial (mixed vegetables in curd-coconut paste) and seasonal vegetable thoran.

fields.name: Matta Rice with Green Gram Curry
fields.description: Wholesome red matta rice paired with stewed whole green gram curry, crushed shallots, and fresh curry leaves.

fields.name: Ela Ada
fields.description: Classic Kerala delicacy of rice parcels filled with sweet coconut and jaggery, steamed inside fragrant banana leaves.

fields.name: Light Chicken Stew with Whole-Wheat Chapati
fields.description: Whole-wheat chapatis paired with tender chicken pieces gently stewed with carrots, potatoes, and mild whole spices.

fields.description: Crunchy oven-roasted whole peanuts seasoned lightly with salt and roasted cumin, packed with healthy fats and protein.

fields.description: Naturally sweet ripe Kerala Nendran banana gently steamed in its skin, preserving dietary fibers and essential potassium.

fields.name: Egg Curry with Whole-Wheat Chapati
fields.description: Nutritious whole-wheat flatbreads served with boiled eggs in a mildly spiced tomato, onion, and coconut curry.

fields.name: Grilled Chicken with Vegetables
fields.description: Herb-marinated lean chicken breast grilled to perfection and served with a colorful medley of sautéed garden vegetables.

fields.name: Tofu and Vegetable Stir-Fry

fields.name: Puttu with Green Gram Curry

fields.name: Ragi Puttu with Cherupayar
fields.description: Calcium and iron-rich finger millet (ragi) steamed puttu with grated coconut, served with savory boiled green gram curry.
fields.malayalam_description: പോഷകസമ്പുഷ്ടമായ റാഗി പുട്ടും നാടൻ ചെറുപയർ കറിയും.

fields.name: Idiyappam with Vegetable Stew
fields.description: Tender steamed rice string hoppers paired with aromatic, mild vegetable stew gently simmered in fresh coconut milk with whole spices.
fields.malayalam_description: മൃദുവായ ഇടിയപ്പവും നാളികേരപ്പാലിൽ തയ്യാറാക്കിയ നാടൻ വെജിറ്റബിൾ സ്റ്റൂവും.

fields.name: Kerala Vegetable Oats Upma
fields.description: Wholesome rolled oats roasted and tossed with carrots, french beans, green peas, roasted cashews, and traditional Kerala spices.
fields.malayalam_description: പച്ചക്കറികളും കശുവണ്ടിയും ചേർത്ത ആരോഗ്യകരമായ ഓട്സ് ഉപ്പുമാവ്.

fields.name: Idli with Vegetable Sambar
fields.description: Traditional fermented rice and black gram idlis served with home-style Kerala sambar packed with drumsticks, pumpkin, and roasted coriander.
fields.malayalam_description: മൃദുവായ ഇഡ്ഡലിയും മുരിങ്ങക്കായ് ചേർത്ത രുചികരമായ സാമ്പാറും.

fields.name: Kerala Matta Rice with Vegetable Avial
fields.description: Nutrient-dense boiled Kerala matta rice served with authentic avial made of drumstick, yam, raw plantain, and carrots in coarse coconut-cumin paste.
fields.malayalam_description: തവിട് കളയാത്ത മട്ടയരി ചോറും നാടൻ നാളികേര അരപ്പിൽ തയ്യാറാക്കിയ സ്വാദിഷ്ടമായ അവിയലും.

fields.name: Matta Rice with Fish Curry
fields.description: Wholesome Kerala red matta rice served with traditional tangy kudampuli fish curry simmered with shallots, ginger, and Kashmiri chilli in a clay pot.
fields.malayalam_description: കുടംപുളിയിട്ട് മൺചട്ടിയിൽ വെച്ച നാടൻ മീൻകറിയും മട്ടയരി ചോറും.

fields.name: Matta Rice with Cherupayar Thoran
fields.description: Steamed Kerala red rice served with savory dry-roasted green gram thoran tossed with freshly grated coconut, crushed shallots, and green chillies.
fields.malayalam_description: നാടൻ മട്ടയരി ചോറും തേങ്ങ ചിരവിയിട്ട ചെറുപയർ തോരനും.

fields.name: Kerala Vegetable Sambar with Rice
fields.description: Hearty red matta rice served with slow-cooked toor dal sambar rich in seasonal Kerala vegetables, flavoured with freshly roasted sambar spices.
fields.malayalam_description: തവിടുള്ള മട്ടച്ചോറും നാടൻ സുഗന്ധവ്യഞ്ജനക്കൂട്ടിൽ തയ്യാറാക്കിയ സാമ്പാറും.

fields.name: Pumpkin Erissery with Matta Rice
fields.description: Sweet yellow pumpkin and cowpeas simmered in ground coconut paste, finished with aromatic fried coconut shreds, served with hot matta rice.
fields.malayalam_description: മത്തങ്ങയും വൻപയറും ചേർത്ത് തേങ്ങ വറുത്തിട്ട രുചികരമായ എരിശ്ശേരിയും ചോറും.

fields.name: Matta Rice with Grilled Kerala-Spiced Fish
fields.description: High-fiber red matta rice accompanied by an authentic Kerala-spiced pan-grilled fish fillet marinated with ginger, garlic, crushed pepper, and lemon juice.
fields.malayalam_description: എരിവും മണവുമുള്ള നാടൻ മസാല പുരട്ടി ചുട്ടെടുത്ത മീനും മട്ടയരി ചോറും.

fields.name: Steamed Kozhukatta with Green Gram Filling
fields.description: Soft steamed rice dumplings packed with a wholesome savory-sweet green gram and grated coconut filling seasoned with cardamom and shallots.
fields.malayalam_description: ചെറുപയറും നാളികേരവും ചേർത്തുള്ള സ്വാദിഷ്ടമായ നാടൻ കൊഴുക്കട്ട.

fields.name: Steamed Ragi Puttu Bites
fields.description: Nutritious bite-sized finger millet puttu cubes tossed with freshly scraped coconut and a hint of cardamom; packed with fiber and micronutrients.
fields.malayalam_description: റാഗിയും തേങ്ങയും ചേർത്ത മൃദുവായ ചെറു പുട്ടുകൾ.
